import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split
from sklearn.preprocessing import StandardScaler
from sklearn.metrics import log_loss
from sklearn.preprocessing import LabelEncoder
from lightgbm import LGBMClassifier
import os

os.makedirs("./submission", exist_ok=True)

# Load data
train = pd.read_csv("input/train.csv")
test = pd.read_csv("input/test.csv")
sample_submission = pd.read_csv("input/sample_submission.csv")

print(f"Train shape: {train.shape}")
print(f"Test shape: {test.shape}")
print(f"Sample submission shape: {sample_submission.shape}")

# Get feature columns (all except id and species)
feature_cols = [c for c in train.columns if c not in ["id", "species"]]
n_features = len(feature_cols)
print(f"Number of features: {n_features}")

# Encode species target variable properly
le = LabelEncoder()
y_train = le.fit_transform(train["species"])
n_classes = len(le.classes_)
print(f"Number of classes: {n_classes}")
print(f"Unique classes: {le.classes_[:10]}...")

# Separate features and labels
X_train = train[feature_cols].fillna(0).values
X_test = test[feature_cols].fillna(0).values
test_ids = test["id"].values

# Create proper validation split BEFORE training (stratified)
val_ratio = 0.2
X_train_cv, X_val, y_train_cv, y_val = train_test_split(
    X_train, y_train, test_size=val_ratio, random_state=42, stratify=y_train
)

# Scale features after splitting
scaler = StandardScaler()
X_train_scaled = scaler.fit_transform(X_train_cv)
X_val_scaled = scaler.transform(X_val)
X_test_scaled = scaler.transform(X_test)

# Model configuration
clf1 = LGBMClassifier(
    n_estimators=500,
    learning_rate=0.05,
    max_depth=7,
    num_leaves=31,
    min_child_samples=20,
    subsample=0.8,
    colsample_bytree=0.8,
    reg_alpha=0.01,
    reg_lambda=0.1,
    verbose=-1,
    force_col_wise=False,
    random_state=42,
    n_jobs=-1,
)

# Fit model on validation-only data
print("Training model on training subset...")
clf1.fit(X_train_scaled, y_train_cv)

# Evaluate on hold-out validation set (model never saw these during training)
val_preds = clf1.predict_proba(X_val_scaled)
val_logloss = log_loss(y_val, val_preds)
print(f"Validation LogLoss (hold-out): {val_logloss:.6f}")

# Generate predictions for test set
test_preds = clf1.predict_proba(X_test_scaled)

# Apply probability clipping to avoid log loss extremes
test_preds = np.clip(test_preds, 1e-15, 1 - 1e-15)

# Create submission file with proper format
sorted_species = sorted(sample_submission.columns.drop("id"))
print(f"Species in submission: {len(sorted_species)}")

submission = pd.DataFrame(test_ids.reshape(-1, 1), columns=["id"])
for i, species in enumerate(sorted_species):
    submission[species] = test_preds[:, i]

# Save submission to required location
submission.to_csv("./submission/submission.csv", index=False)

print(f"Submission saved to ./submission/submission.csv")
print(f"Validation metric (multi-class log loss): {val_logloss:.6f}")
